Use it on an aircraft to bind it, then hold it to find that aircraft. Use it while flying to open the flight menu.
item.immersive_aircraft.autopilot.descri: Goes in a weapon slot. Click to engage: climbs to a safe height and flies to your destination.
item.immersive_aircraft.light_machine_gu: Fast and light. Aims where its gunner looks. Fires gunpowder.
item.immersive_aircraft.medium_machine_g: Hits harder than the light one, fires a little slower. Fires gunpowder.
item.immersive_aircraft.heavy_machine_gu: Slow and punchy. Aims where its gunner looks. Fires gunpowder.
item.immersive_aircraft.light_autocannon: Rapid cannon shells. Fires iron nuggets.
item.immersive_aircraft.medium_autocanno: Heavier shells, slower fire. Fires iron nuggets.
item.immersive_aircraft.heavy_autocannon: The heaviest rapid shells. Fires iron nuggets.
item.immersive_aircraft.light_cannon.des: Fires forward. Small blast, barely scratches blocks. Fires iron ingots.
item.immersive_aircraft.medium_cannon.de: Fires forward. A bigger blast that breaks some blocks. Fires iron ingots.
item.immersive_aircraft.heavy_cannon.des: Fires forward. Huge blast, tears through blocks. Fires iron ingots.
item.immersive_aircraft.light_rocket_pod: Volleys of small rockets. No block damage. Fires firework rockets.
item.immersive_aircraft.medium_rocket_po: Bigger rockets, still no block damage. Fires firework rockets.
item.immersive_aircraft.heavy_rocket_pod: Heavy rockets that break blocks. Fires firework rockets.
item.immersive_aircraft.heavy_bomb.descr: A big bomb with a big blast that breaks blocks. Uses TNT.
item.immersive_aircraft.cluster_bomb.des: Splits into seven small bombs over a wide area. Uses TNT.
item.immersive_aircraft.guided_bomb.desc: Steers toward wherever the gunner who dropped it is looking. Uses TNT.
item.immersive_aircraft.torpedo.descript: Drop it on water: it runs straight ahead and explodes on what it hits. Uses TNT.
item.immersive_aircraft.depth_charge.des: Sinks in water and explodes deep down. Uses TNT.
item.immersive_aircraft.heat_seeking_mis: Locks onto the nearest target ahead. Flares fool it. Fires firework rockets.
item.immersive_aircraft.radar_guided_mis: Locks onto whatever its gunner is looking at. Ignores flares. Fires firework rockets.
Drops bright flares that pull heat-seeking missiles away. Uses fire charges.
Lays a thick smoke screen behind the aircraft. Uses coal.
item.immersive_aircraft.armor_piercing_r: +30% gun damage, and even more against players and armored mobs.
item.immersive_aircraft.high_explosive_r: -15% direct damage, but bullets and shells burst on impact.
Twice the bombs from every TNT, dropped twice as fast.
item.immersive_aircraft.gunner_control_s: Passengers get their own light machine gun (the pilot cannot use them). Uses gunpowder from the cargo.
item.immersive_aircraft.supercharger.des: +30% engine power and faster acceleration, +50% fuel use.
item.immersive_aircraft.afterburner_modu: Jets only: push the stick forward twice quickly for +80% speed for 9 seconds (+80% fuel use while lit).
item.immersive_aircraft.reinforced_airfr: +25% durability, -30% wind effect, a little slower to accelerate and turn.
item.immersive_aircraft.external_cargo_h: Hook a mob or item hanging below the aircraft from the flight menu. -15% speed while carrying.
item.immersive_aircraft.parachute_system: Anyone who leaves the aircraft in the air floats down safely.
item.immersive_aircraft.searchlight.desc: Lights up the ground below the aircraft at night.
item.immersive_aircraft.iron_striker.des: A tough ground-attack plane with an armored cockpit and a rear gunner.
item.immersive_aircraft.steel_bomber.des: A huge four-crew bomber built to carry heavy loads a long way.
item.immersive_aircraft.metal_jet.descri: A fast twin-jet fighter for chasing down anything in the sky.
item.immersive_aircraft.iron_freighter.d: A three-engine transport for six people and a whole lot of cargo.
item.immersive_aircraft.swift_scout.desc: A light recon plane that takes off and lands in almost no space.
item.immersive_aircraft.torpedo_plane.de: A sturdy three-seat biplane made for hunting ships with torpedoes.
item.immersive_aircraft.jet_bomber.descr: A jet-powered bomber that gets in and out before anyone can react.
item.immersive_aircraft.strike_jet.descr: A heavily armored jet with a huge nose gun for close air support.
item.immersive_aircraft.dive_bomber.desc: Dives straight down onto its target for pinpoint bombing.
item.immersive_aircraft.heavy_fighter.de: A twin-engine fighter with heavy forward guns and a rear gunner.
Slow and heavily armored, built around a massive forward cannon.
item.immersive_aircraft.lightning_fighte: A fast, agile fighter made for dogfights.
item.immersive_aircraft.flanker_jet.desc: A big two-seat jet that does it all: dogfights and ground attack.
item.immersive_aircraft.fulcrum_jet.desc: An agile jet fighter built for air superiority.
